title: Modi Greets Indian Contingent at World Nomad Games Opening in Kyrgyzstan
excerpt: India sent an 87-member delegation including 73 athletes to the sixth World Nomad Games in Bishkek, held on the sidelines of the SCO Summit.
body:
• PM Modi attended the opening ceremony of the 6th World Nomad Games at Bishkek Arena on August 31
  • India sent an 87-member delegation including 73 athletes, 10 cultural representatives and 4 scientific participants
  • The games feature 3,000 athletes from 112 countries competing in 43 traditional sports disciplines
  • Modi travelled to the ceremony with Russian President Putin after bilateral talks on the SCO Summit sidelines

Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended the opening ceremony of the sixth World Nomad Games at Bishkek Arena in the Kyrgyz capital on Sunday, greeting the Indian contingent as athletes carrying the national flag entered the arena.

India's Presence

India has sent an 87-member delegation to the games, comprising 73 athletes, 10 cultural representatives and four participants in the scientific programme. The delegation will compete across multiple disciplines in the week-long event running from August 31 to September 6.

"Attended the opening ceremony of the World Nomad Games in Bishkek. My best wishes to the Indian contingent," Modi posted on X after the event. The Ministry of External Affairs noted that the games celebrate "the rich sporting traditions, culture and heritage of nomadic civilisations."

The Nomad Olympics

The World Nomad Games, often described as the Olympics of the nomadic world, are held every two years and bring together participants from across the globe to compete in traditional sports. The 2026 edition features 3,000 athletes from 112 countries competing in 43 disciplines, including traditional wrestling forms such as Goresh, Kurash and Mongol Bokh, along with Kok Boru (goat polo), horseback wrestling, traditional archery, falconry and strongman competitions.

India has won eight medals across five editions, including one gold and five bronze medals in Kurash (belt wrestling) at the 2024 edition in Astana, Kazakhstan. India's gold came in the women's 57kg category, where Pinky Balhara defeated her Kazakh opponent.

Diplomatic Context

Modi's attendance came on the sidelines of the 26th Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit. In a notable display of personal rapport, Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin travelled to Bishkek Arena in the same car immediately after concluding their bilateral discussions.

"PM Modi, along with other SCO leaders, participated in the official opening ceremony of the 6th World Nomad Games in Bishkek."

— Randhir Jaiswal, MEA Spokesperson

Other leaders at the ceremony included Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan and Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif. Modi is visiting Bishkek at the invitation of Kyrgyz President Sadyr Zhaparov.

What's Ahead

The main sporting events will take place across venues in Cholpon-Ata, Kyrchyn and other locations around the Issyk-Kul region over the coming week. For the Indian diaspora, the games represent a growing but largely unfollowed area of international sports where India is building a competitive presence in traditional athletic disciplines.
